findings.summary: `rules += active_promos(now)` mutates the list cached by lru_cache in place, so promos accumulate across quotes (duplicate discounts, expired promos persisting, unbounded memory growth, and promos leaking into the /rules API).
No test calls price_quote with the cache, so nothing covers the cache/engine interaction; a test calling price_quote twice with an active promo and checking the discount is stable is missing.
The final save_rules(... value=12) restore step has no assertion and isn't in a finally/fixture, so a failure earlier leaves the shared db._RULES mutated.
cache_clear() only clears the cache in the calling process, so with multiple workers other processes serve stale rules after save_rules (also clears all tenants' entries, a minor extra DB read cost).
